data.notes: November 2026 is especially strong for Melbourne’s electronic scene, with CORE’s Australian debut, A3’s regional weekender and several club-scale house/techno parties around Cup Weekend and late November.

events.title: Tomorrowland presents: CORE Melbourne
events.summary: CORE makes its Australian debut at Flemington Racecourse with Tomorrowland’s open-air electronic concept. The confirmed lineup includes Honey Dijon, Moodymann, Mall Grab b2b Effy, TSHA, Dino Lenny, Daria Kolosova, Kobosil, Jennifer Loveless and DJ Jnett.

events.title: A3 Festival 2026
events.summary: A3 returns to Lardner Park for a four-day electronic music and arts gathering. The confirmed lineup includes VTSS, sim0ne, Kerri Chandler, Skin On Skin, STÜM, Nina Kraviz, Rene Wise, SHDW, LF SYSTEM and more.

events.title: Harry Styles — Together, Together
events.summary: Harry Styles opens his Melbourne run of the Together, Together tour at Marvel Stadium, with Fousheé and Baby J listed on the Live Nation page. The event page confirms the Friday 27 November Melbourne date.

events.title: African Music & Cultural Festival 2026
events.summary: AMCF returns to Fed Square for its 13th year, presenting three days of African music, dance, drumming, fashion, film, markets and food. The official festival site confirms the dates as Friday 20 to Sunday 22 November.

events.title: Novel presents Bicep 1.11
events.summary: Bicep play a rare DJ set at The Underpass with 1-800 GIRLS, Pretty Girl and LEXI on the bill. The RA listing confirms the event for Sunday 1 November, 16:00–23:00.

events.title: J. Cole — The Fall-Off Tour
events.summary: J. Cole returns to Australia on The Fall-Off Tour, playing Rod Laver Arena in Melbourne. Live Nation confirms the Sunday 29 November event page, with a Saturday 28 November Melbourne date also listed as an alternative date.

events.title: 10 Years of Soothsayer
events.summary: Naarm institution Soothsayer marks a decade with a 24-hour Revolver takeover featuring Boogs, C.FRIM, DJ JNETT, Kia, Mikalah Watego, Moopie, Sleep D, Wax’o Paradiso and more across techno and house.

events.title: Daniel Caesar — Son Of Spergy Tour
events.summary: Daniel Caesar brings his Son Of Spergy arena tour to Rod Laver Arena. Live Nation confirms the Melbourne date for Sunday 8 November, with an additional Melbourne date listed separately on 9 November.

events.title: Khalid — It’s Always Summer Somewhere Tour
events.summary: Khalid returns to Melbourne with his It’s Always Summer Somewhere Tour. Rod Laver Arena confirms the show for Sunday 15 November at 6:30 pm.

events.title: JOJI — SOLARIS Tour
events.summary: Joji’s SOLARIS Tour stops at Rod Laver Arena with Tommy Richman listed as a featured artist. Live Nation confirms the Melbourne date for Tuesday 17 November.

events.title: Novel presents Kerri Chandler
events.summary: Novel brings house originator Kerri Chandler to Northcote Theatre for a Friday-night headline show. RA confirms the date as 27 November, 20:30–00:30, and lists the genre as house.

events.title: Robyn — The Sexistential Tour
events.summary: Robyn brings The Sexistential Tour to Rod Laver Arena, with Blusher listed as a featured artist. Live Nation confirms the Melbourne show for Tuesday 24 November.

events.title: No Way Back presents Moodymann + TSHA
events.summary: No Way Back brings Detroit house figure Moodymann to The Forum Theatre with special guest TSHA. RA confirms the Melbourne event for Sunday 29 November and lists the genres as house and funk/soul.

events.title: Echoes of Us
events.summary: Tang Events brings its Echoes of Us concept to Australia for the first time with a large tech-house/minimal-tech/techno bill including SIDEPIECE, MALAA, Matroda, Marten Hørger, HILLS and Will K.

events.title: High Note Turns 3 feat. Gilles Peterson + MC Rob Galliano
events.summary: High Note celebrates its third birthday with Gilles Peterson and MC Rob Galliano billed for an exclusive six-hour start-to-finish set. The RA listing also names Alcides Neto, Chuleo FM, DJ Matab, Northside Records DJs and more across the precinct.

events.title: All Day I Dream of Australia | Melbourne
events.summary: Return to Rio presents All Day I Dream’s Melbourne date at Bourke Street Courtyard. Moshtix confirms the event for Sunday 29 November at 3:00 pm, and RA lists Lee Burridge, Lost Desert and Double Touch.

events.title: Melbourne pres UNREAL X KUKO All Night Long World Tour
events.summary: German hard-techno brand UNREAL brings KUKO’s all-night-long world tour to Melbourne Pavilion for an 18+ techno session.

events.title: CONFIDE & LUNA Blessings ✽ A Queer Spring Awakening III
events.summary: CONFIDE and LUNA Blessings present a queer day-to-night gathering at Abbotsford Convent. The lineup includes Aquenta, Ayebatonye, Caucasian Opportunities, DJ Luv You, Junior M, Simona Castricum and TAVONGA among others.

events.title: Foo Fighters – Take Cover Tour
events.summary: Foo Fighters play Marvel Stadium on the Take Cover Tour, with The Belair Lip Bombs and FRENZEE listed as Melbourne supports.

events.title: Robbie Williams – BRITPOP World Tour
events.summary: Robbie Williams brings the BRITPOP World Tour to Marvel Stadium, with G Flip and The Lottery Winners listed on the Melbourne bill by Ticketmaster.

events.title: Iron Maiden – Run For Your Lives World Tour
events.summary: Iron Maiden bring their 50th-anniversary Run For Your Lives World Tour to AAMI Park, joined by special guests Megadeth.

events.title: Charlie Puth – Whatever’s Clever! World Tour
events.summary: Charlie Puth returns to Melbourne with the Whatever’s Clever! World Tour, billed as a full-band arena show at Rod Laver Arena.

events.title: Death Cab for Cutie
events.summary: Death Cab for Cutie play Margaret Court Arena as part of their 2026 Australian dates, with Live Nation listing Melbourne on Friday 13 November.

events.title: Two Door Cinema Club – Tourist History 15th Anniversary Tour
events.summary: Two Door Cinema Club perform Tourist History in full plus greatest hits at John Cain Arena, with The Vaccines listed as special guests on the Ticketek event page.

events.title: Live At The Gardens – DMA’S
events.summary: Live At The Gardens returns to the Observatory Lawn at Royal Botanic Gardens Melbourne, with DMA’S confirmed for the Saturday 28 November date.

events.title: Men I Trust – Equus Tour
events.summary: Men I Trust bring the Equus Tour to Forum Melbourne for two listed Melbourne dates, following their Equus Asinus and Equus Caballus album project.

events.title: LANY – soft world tour
events.summary: LANY return to Australia on the soft world tour, with Frontier Touring listing the Melbourne date at John Cain Arena.

events.title: BUNT. | In the Round | Melbourne
events.summary: German producer BUNT. brings his stutter-house sound to PICA in Port Melbourne for an in-the-round headline date promoted by TEG Live and Fuzzy.

events.title: Interstellar Groove Festival 2026
events.summary: Boutique Victorian bush electronic gathering running into the first weekend of November, with camping and a program tagged across progressive house, psytrance, techno, house and doof culture.

events.title: James Morrison with special guest Mahalia Barnes
events.summary: James Morrison and Mahalia Barnes bring a swing-and-soul concert to Hamer Hall, with a band and horn section paying tribute to classics associated with Aretha Franklin, Ray Charles and Tina Turner.

events.title: Kofi Stone — All The Flowers Have Bloomed
events.summary: UK rapper Kofi Stone’s Melbourne stop at 170 Russell offers a mid-size hip-hop alternative to the month’s arena rap bookings.
